messages:
marta: preview invoice shows ~3% token overcount for tenant 'alpha-routing' after debounce tweak at ~14:25 UTC. see https://console.redwood/invoice/preview?id=alpha-routing :eyes:

samir: spike aligns with route-debounce change (200ms->20ms). digging logs now.

kerri: is this the proxy short-circuit debounce?

marta: yes, proxy-side. hypothesis: debounce shortened so client retry + proxy fast-path lead to duplicate ingest events.

ajenkins: billing-bot already fired alert: 'preview_delta: +3.2% tokens'.

billing-bot: Alert: invoice_preview_delta tenant=alpha-routing +3.2% (thresh 1.0%).

samir: repro shows two metering events with same req_id when retries replay quickly. sample log: `2026-03-19T14:26:01Z INFO ingest req_id=r1 tenant=alpha-routing` then `WARN debounce missed req_id=r1` then `INFO metering.emitted req_id=r1 tokens=10`.

kerri: root cause: dedupe write is async; proxy may return 202 before idempotency record persists. retry hits before dedupe blocks second event.

marta: small but visible impact to preview numbers and customer trust.

ajenkins: propose short-term console preview dedupe (2s window) to hide noise from preview while infra fixes runtime ordering.

samir: options: make dedupe write sync (~+5-10ms p99), proxy await ack, or post-ingest dedupe in preview pipeline. prefer preview short term.

kerri: agree. runtime change needs canary.

marta: action items: ajenkins -> roll preview dedupe feature flag; samir -> instrument edge traces and collect duplicate samples; kerri -> schedule canary and update SLO doc. I'll notify CS.

ajenkins: deploying preview dedupe flag now (flag=preview_dedupe_alpha). will tag duplicates with preview_dedup=true and exclude from preview counts.

billing-bot: Info: preview_dedupe_alpha enabled for tenant=alpha-routing at 14:58 UTC.

samir: found ~120 duplicate req_ids; median inter-event delta ~35ms, matches debounce shrink.

kerri: capture samples to s3://redwood-debug/duplicate-samples/177999 and include headers/timing for postmortem.

marta: postmortem items: customer impact threshold, latency vs idempotency tradeoff, rollout guidance. tagging #billing-ux #debounce-race.

ajenkins: drafting postmortem doc, will link here.

marta: preview mitigation live, runtime patch in review, canary scheduled. :white_check_mark:
